messages:
marta: Quick sync — I ran into a corner case when we switch noisy tenants to per-tenant fanout + lease, and keep sparse tenants on append-only flow. Late credits from sparse tenants are causing duplicate-looking credits during cross-shard reconciliation. Anyone seen this pattern?

arjun: Yep. Seen it in the Canary test. Root cause is the lease-granularity mismatch — the append-only path uses event timestamps, fanout path uses lease epochs, and our reconcile dedupe assumes a single timeline.

jen: TL;DR: two timelines = reconciliation blind spots. We either normalize to a canonical timeline at ingestion or add cross-walk metadata so reconciler can map epoch->event-time.

leo: Adding canonicalization at the router sounds expensive. What about adding a small provenance envelope: {source_path, lease_epoch, ingest_ts, fingerprint}? That keeps cost low and gives reconciler enough to resolve duplicates.

sam: I prototyped a provenance envelope last week. Minimal size (≈200 bytes) and didn't change throughput in local perf. Reconciler needed 3 heuristics: prefer larger-claim_id, prefer later ingest_ts up to grace window, then fingerprint compare.

marta: Can you paste the prototype heuristics, sam?

sam: Sure — gist:
```
// reconcile pseudocode
if (claim_id conflict) {
  if (abs(ingest_tsA - ingest_tsB) > GRACE_WINDOW) return newer;
  if (fingerprintA == fingerprintB) return merge;
  // otherwise prefer path with lease_epoch not null (fanout) to avoid double-counting
}
```
GRACE_WINDOW = 5m by default (configurable per-tenant).

arjun: I like the envelope approach. Two followups: 1) how do we surface this metadata for billing (we can't bill on envelope fields directly), and 2) how do we prevent the reconciler from over-preferring fanout when fanout had earlier observed duplicates?

marta: For billing we keep chargeable tokens derived from the canonical event (post-reconcile). Envelope is only for provenance/tracing. We emit an audit event when reconcile chooses/merges so billing has a clear source-of-truth event id.

leo: To avoid bias, the reconciler heuristics should score evidence instead of hard preference. e.g., evidence_score = w1*(ingest_ts_recent) + w2*(lease_epoch_present) + w3*(fingerprint_match). Pick max score, threshold for merge. That lets us tune weights per-tenant.

jen: Agree. Also need to consider cross-region: lease_epoch might be region-scoped, so include region tag in envelope. Otherwise replicas look different.

marta: Good call. Include region and an origin_uuid in envelope. Sam, can you add region/origin to the prototype and run the canary again?

sam: On it. Will push changes to the canary today. Quick note: we should also add a reconciliation metric: reconciles_per_hour, reconciled_token_delta, and reconcile_conflict_ratio.

billing-bot: FYI — any change that modifies the canonical event must go through billing-signoff. Please open a PR with the reconcile audit event shape before canary rollout.

marta: Will do. Action items: 1) sam: add region/origin and evidence scoring to prototype, run canary (ETA EOD). 2) arjun/leo: sketch reconciler scoring doc + config knobs (weights, grace window). 3) jen: update billing audit event schema with `canonical_event_id` + `reconcile_reason`. 4) ops: add metrics from sam's comment and an alert if reconcile_conflict_ratio > 0.5% sustained.

leo: Question — rolling migration plan? My suggestion: start with 10 heavy tenants to fanout+lease, keep rest append-only, watch reconcile metrics for 48h, then broaden.

marta: Sounds good. Also add a cheap, short-lived feature flag to force append-only for a tenant while we debug.

arjun: One more thought: to reduce false positives on duplicates, we can build a small in-memory forgiveness window at the fanout ingress that collapses near-duplicates (same fingerprint within 30s) before emitting. Cheap and prevents churn downstream.

sam: That would help. We can gate it behind a cost threshold (only for high-cardinality tenants).

marta: Great. If everyone agrees, I'll create the billing PR and a short RFC with the reconciler heuristics. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy-notice: canary cluster updated with sam/reconcile-proto at 2024-09-11T18:30:00Z

arjun: ack - monitoring in place.

marta: leaving this thread open for canary results — will summarize in the RFC follow-up doc.
